result.reason: The added operative language meets every preferred requirement and therefore also meets the fallback, with longer-than-fallback warranty periods. It adds no unrelated commercial obligation and leaves the existing warranties intact. Drafting quality is only moderate because the new paragraph lacks a subsection label, “this warranty” is imprecise when several warranties precede it, the remedy language does not clearly allocate the choice among repair, replacement, and refund, and the 12-month warranty for all deliverables and software is tied to acceptance of the Site rather than acceptance or delivery of the relevant item.
